 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Vaccum"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is** "Vacuum".** "Vaccum" is not a valid English word. (निष्प्राण जगह)

 
 
• **Example: **There was no sound in the** vaccum o**f space.
 
 
 
• **"Vacuum" **refers to a space entirely devoid of matter, including air, or to a device used for cleaning by suction. (निर्वात)
 
 
• **Example: **"The scientists created a** vacuum** in the laboratory to conduct their experiments without any interference from air or other particles."
 
 

Therefore, the correct spelling is** 'vacuum.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Perceive** (अनुभव करना): To become aware or conscious of something; to realize or understand.

 
 
• **Example:** I could **perceive** a change in his attitude.
 
 
 
• **Recognition** (पहचान): The action or process of recognizing or being recognized.
 
 
• **Example: **She received **recognition** for her outstanding contributions to the field.
 
 
 
• **Shield** (ढाल): A broad piece of armor, varying widely in form and size, carried apart from the body, usually on the left arm, as a defense against swords, lances, arrows, etc.
 
 
• **Example:** The knight raised his **shield** to block the incoming arrows.
